definitions.explanation: Attached to verb stems or nouns to indicate that something has been completed or is already done.

examples.japanese: ⟦{支払|しはら}い→支払い：03193_shiharai⟧{済|ず}み⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧。
⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧。

notes:
From the verb ⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧ (to be finished), voiced to ずみ after a noun: Noun + {済|ず}み. The result works as a noun or a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective: ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧, {支払|しはら}い{済|ず}みです.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {支払|しはら}い{済|ず}み (paid)
- ⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧{済|ず}み (confirmed/verified)
- ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧{済|ず}み (used/spent)
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧{済|ず}み (reserved)
- ⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧{済|ず}み (processed)
- ⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧{済|ず}み (registered)

USAGE: Very common on forms, labels and in business to mark a task as done. Labels often drop the kana: {支払済|しはらいずみ}, {検査済|けんさずみ}.
